title: Signal Runtime Recovery Inspector Demo

launch.notes: Bootstraps the existing signal-runtime supervisor report example, records a machine-readable receipt, and emits a rendered operator companion view.

scenarios.title: Runtime Recovery Inspector Bootstrap
scenarios.summary: Exercises the runtime supervisor report example and captures watchdog, plugin-fault, and degraded-surface truth through one repo-owned demo surface.

evidence.notes: This bootstrap surface proves runtime recovery inspection without widening into host comparison or plugin browsing.

known_exclusions: Host comparison remains deferred to later g09.012 batches.
Plugin capability browsing remains deferred to later g09.012 batches.
This bootstrap manifest does not yet claim signal-supervisor-tools live coverage.
expected_checks: The runtime report records handshaken, configured, and running state.
The runtime report records the watchdog trigger snapshot.
The runtime report records plugin timeout fault history.
The runtime report keeps safe-mode and degraded external-surface posture explicit.
The rendered companion view makes runtime recovery posture visually inspectable without reading raw JSON first.
